summary.en: Closed-front storage for a coordinated entryway or room scheme.
summary.zh: 用封闭式柜门整理入户或室内收纳区域。

description.en:
A white storage cabinet shown with several doors and a raised lower plinth. The closed-front design keeps the overall appearance simple while you plan storage around the room.
Confirm the internal shelf layout, dimensions, ventilation and intended contents for your selected configuration.
description.zh:
白色储物柜采用多门正面及下部底座布局，便于在规划收纳时保持整体外观简洁。
请按所选配置核对内部隔板、尺寸、通风及拟存放物品。

en: White front with a simple cabinet profile.
Internal shelving and intended use confirmed before ordering.
zh: 白色正面与简洁柜体轮廓。
下单前核对内部隔板及实际用途。

value.en: Request model-specific order and sample terms
value.zh: 按款式询价确认起订量及样品条件

value.en: Confirm packing, assembly requirements and current lead time
value.zh: 核对包装、组装要求及当前交期
